events.text: Implemented V4L2 capability-based discovery: /dev/video1 and /dev/video3 are correctly filtered as metadata-only; usable choices are USB3 Video (/dev/video0) and OBSBOT Tiny 2 (/dev/video2). The Animation surface now has a named device menu, opens it on first visit when multiple cameras exist, persists the chosen source, rescans on demand, and remounts both RenderTarget + pose loop on switch.

resolution: Added a real camera-source chooser to Globals to Animation. The Zig host now enumerates Linux V4L2 nodes, validates VIDIOC_QUERYCAP capabilities, and filters metadata-only companions, so this machine presents USB3 Video at /dev/video0 and OBSBOT Tiny 2 at /dev/video2. The first visit opens the named picker automatically when multiple cameras exist; selection persists, can be rescanned, and cleanly remounts both RenderTarget and the async pose loop. Added framework and bridge coverage, a passing ReleaseFast editor build, an end-to-end self-capture of the open menu, and a 60-second 667-request gate with zero frame-budget spikes.
